sendspin_cast_experimental.label: Sendspin on Cast devices is experimental. Playback is rarely in sync out of the box, so you will probably have to set the playback delay for this speaker by hand. Some recent Cast firmwares cannot run Sendspin at all, and there is no way to tell in advance: you only find out the first time you play something.

sendspin_static_delay.label: Static playback delay (ms)
sendspin_static_delay.description: Offset in milliseconds to keep this player in sync with other players. Increase if audio plays too late, for example to compensate for latency from an amp, active speakers, or the OS.

preferred_sendspin_format.label: Preferred audio format
preferred_sendspin_format.description: Select the audio format to use for playback on this player.

allow_legacy_clients.label: Allow legacy clients
allow_legacy_clients.description:
Accept legacy Sendspin clients that don't implement the current specification, including clients that connect without encryption, so their traffic can be intercepted on the local network. 
Disable this to accept only spec-compliant clients and to stop holding back newer protocol behavior. 
This option is temporary and will be removed in a future release.

min_pin_length.label: Minimum pairing code length
min_pin_length.description: Minimum number of digits for dynamic pairing codes.

security_status_disconnected.label: The device disconnected and will reappear once it reconnects.

security_status_unencrypted.label: This device is connected without encryption (legacy mode). Pairing is not available.

security_status_paired.label: This device is paired. The connection is encrypted and authenticated.

security_status_guest.label: This device is connected through guest access. The connection is encrypted but not verified, which the device allows on purpose.

security_status_guest_pairable.label: This device is connected through guest access. It also supports pairing for a permanent, verified connection - use Reconfigure to set that up.

pairing_error_handshake.label: The secure connection to the device failed during pairing. Please try again.

option_descriptions.dynamic_pin: Enter the device's dynamically generated pairing code.
option_descriptions.static_pin: Enter the device's fixed pairing code.

unpair.label: Unpair
unpair.description: Remove the pairing with this device. Both sides forget the stored credential and the device reconnects as unpaired.

management_enter.label: Manage device settings
management_enter.description: Change the device's own pairing settings. While the management section is open, the device rejects connections from other servers.

management_status.label: Managing device settings. The device rejects other servers until this section is closed.

management_static_pin_enable.label: Enable static pairing code
management_static_pin_enable.description: Let the device accept new pairings using its static pairing code.

management_static_pin_disable.label: Disable static pairing code
management_static_pin_disable.description: Stop the device from accepting new pairings using its static pairing code.

management_dynamic_pin_enable.label: Enable dynamic pairing code
management_dynamic_pin_enable.description: Let the device accept new pairings using a dynamic pairing code it provides while pairing.

management_dynamic_pin_disable.label: Disable dynamic pairing code
management_dynamic_pin_disable.description: Stop the device from accepting new pairings using a dynamic pairing code it provides while pairing.

management_error_permission_denied.label: The device refused the management request.

management_error_already_exists.label: The entry already exists on the device.

management_error_invalid.label: The device rejected the request as invalid.

management_error_not_found.label: The entry does not exist on the device.

management_error_storage_exhausted.label: The device is out of storage space.

management_error_timeout.label: The device did not respond in time.

management_error_no_session.label: No management session is open for this device.

static_pin_location_device.label: Enter the code printed on the device

static_pin_location_leaflet.label: Enter the code from the leaflet supplied with the device

static_pin_location_operator.label: Enter the code set on the device by its operator

dynamic_pin_channel_display.label: Enter the code shown on the device's screen

dynamic_pin_channel_speaker.label: Enter the code the device reads out loud

source_autostart_target.label: Automatically play line-in on
source_autostart_target.description: Where this device's line-in plays automatically when a signal is detected. Requires the device to report signal presence.

option_descriptions.pair: Sets up a verified connection, which is required before the device may send audio to Music Assistant.
option_descriptions.dismiss: Playback keeps working over guest access. Music Assistant will stop offering this device's audio input.

option_descriptions.unpaired: No pairing needed. Quick and easy, but less secure.
option_descriptions.pair: Sets up a permanent, secure connection with this device.

dynamic_pin_channel_display_speaker.label: Enter the code the device shows on screen or reads out loud

approve_device.title: How do you want to connect?
approve_device.description: You can connect to this device straight away, or set up a secure pairing first. Without pairing the connection can be intercepted.

source_input.title: Audio input available
source_input.description: This device can send its audio (such as a line-in) to Music Assistant. To use the input, the device must be paired.

awaiting_device.title: Waiting for the device
awaiting_device.description: Waiting for the device to start pairing.

awaiting_gesture.title: Put the device in pairing mode
awaiting_gesture.description: Put the device in pairing mode so it can provide its pairing code.
awaiting_gesture.progress_text: Waiting for the pairing gesture on the device...

confirming.title: Finishing pairing
confirming.description: Completing the secure pairing with the device.

verify_pin.title: Verify device presence
verify_pin.description: Enter the device's pairing code to confirm it is the physical device in front of you.

abort.nothing_to_configure: This player has nothing to pair. Bridge and web players, and devices connected without encryption, do not require pairing.
abort.already_paired: This device is already securely paired. To pair it afresh, unpair it first from the player settings.
abort.no_pair_methods: The device does not offer any pairing method.
abort.pairing_error_concurrent: Another pairing attempt is already in progress.
abort.pairing_error_not_connected: The device is no longer connected.
abort.pairing_failed: Pairing with the device failed. Please try again.
abort.timed_out: The device did not respond in time. Run the setup again to retry.
abort.token_pairing_only: This device cannot be paired from here. It only offers the pairing method servers use to enrol themselves, which has no code for you to enter.

approve_device_source.title: How do you want to connect?
approve_device_source.description: You can connect to this device straight away, or set up a secure pairing first. Without pairing the connection can be intercepted. This device can also send audio to Music Assistant. If that input could be sensitive, such as a microphone, pairing is the safer choice.

manifest.description: Sendspin is an audio playback, control and synchronization protocol developed by the Open Home Foundation and is the native playback protocol built into Music Assistant, used for playback to supported clients like the Music Assistant Web interface, supported (mobile) clients and supported hardware

errors.cast_app_members_not_ready: Cast app on {0} did not report ready within 30 seconds.

errors.pairing_error_pin_length: The device rejected the pairing code length.
errors.pairing_error_cancelled: Pairing was cancelled on the device.
errors.pairing_error_method_unsupported: The device does not support this pairing method.
